product_overview: Claudiya.ai is a real-time fraud detection platform that scores transactions using five parallel AI agents and presents the results in a live operational dashboard. It supports admin review, agent visibility, and policy-driven decisioning with compliance guardrails.
core_goals: Score transactions in real time and surface a fraud decision
Fuse signals from multiple AI agents into a single risk result
Provide operational visibility into live transactions, agent health, and risk trends
Allow administrators to review system activity and policy status
Generate transactions for testing and demonstration purposes

features.name: Real-time dashboard
features.description: A live monitoring dashboard that shows key fraud operations metrics, live threat activity, risk trends, and agent pipeline progress.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Observe live KPI metrics, risk trends, and threat activity updating on the dashboard -> Inspect agent pipeline progress and regional capacity indicators
Navigate to / -> Use the search capability to filter visible transactions by order details or decision -> Review the matching transaction entries and their risk signals

features.name: Transaction search and filtering
features.description: Search and narrow transaction records by key transaction attributes for quick investigation.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Activate search using the keyboard shortcut -> Enter an order identifier, customer identifier, decision, or amount -> Review the filtered transaction results
Navigate to / -> Clear the current search query -> See the full transaction list return to the default view

features.name: Agent detail views
features.description: Dedicated pages for understanding how the orchestrator, behavior agent, and device agent contribute to fraud scoring.
user_flows: Navigate to /agents/orchestrator -> Review fusion logic, policy routing, and composite scoring details
Navigate to /agents/behavior -> Review session telemetry, velocity signals, and behavior scoring metrics
Navigate to /agents/device -> Review device fingerprinting signals, trust verdicts, and device scoring metrics

features.name: Pipeline progress and audit visibility
features.description: A progress page for observing the scoring pipeline end-to-end, including audit events and per-agent stage breakdowns.
user_flows: Navigate to /progress -> Review the pipeline stage progression for a transaction -> Inspect the audit event timeline -> Compare per-agent contribution and timing

features.name: Admin panel
features.description: An administrative view for checking agent health, reviewing recent activity, and adjusting policy status.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Review agent health, scores, and latency across the platform -> Inspect recent activity entries -> Change a policy override setting and observe the updated policy state

features.name: Authentication
features.description: JWT-based authentication for accessing protected platform views and current user information.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth -> Enter email and password -> Submit the login form -> See the authenticated session state and access the protected area
Navigate to /auth -> Enter the required registration details -> Submit the registration form -> See confirmation that the account was created
Navigate to /auth -> Sign in -> Open the current user profile view -> See the logged-in user details

features.name: Transaction data generation
features.description: Tools for generating sample transactions, with an option to score generated items through all five agents.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Generate a batch of sample transactions using a chosen pattern -> See the new transactions appear in the system
Navigate to /admin -> Generate and score sample transactions through all agents -> Review the resulting risk scores, decisions, and agent breakdowns

keyFeatures: Live threat feed from API transactions

tables: transactions (order_id, customer_id, amount, risk_score, decision, agent_scores_json, latency_ms)

agents.name: device
agents.function: Fingerprint, ASN, emulator probe, trust verdict

agents.name: transaction
agents.function: Amount patterns, COD flags, payment method
